description: This file defines a React component named ItemSelectionDropdown, which provides a searchable dropdown interface for selecting items based on contentType filters. It manages internal state, handles events like focus, blur, and search input, and renders a list of filtered items. The component integrates with application context and external hooks to manage visibility and filtering logic.

methods.name: ItemSelectionDropdown
methods.description: React functional component for displaying and managing an item selection dropdown with search capabilities.
